question: How many circles does a target have in archery?
solution:
The correct answer is __**10.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A target in archery has **10 circles**.
 
• These circles are **used to score points**, with the **innermost circle scoring the highest points**.
 
• The scoring rings allow archers to target specific areas to maximize their score.
 
• **Each circle has a specific point value**, with values decreasing as one moves outward from the center.
 
• **Archery targets are standardized for competition to ensure fairness and consistency.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Archery Term
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Recurve Bow**
 A type of bow used in Olympic archery, characterized by its distinctive curves at each end.
 
 

 **Compound Bow**
 A modern bow that uses a levering system to reduce the effort needed to draw the bow.
 
 

 **Field Archery**
 A form of archery that involves shooting at targets of varying and often unmarked distance, typically in woodland and rough terrain.
 
 

 **Archery Range**
 A designated area where archers practice shooting and competition takes place.
 
 

 **Olympic Archery**
 A discipline of archery featured in the Olympic Games, involving shooting arrows at a target over a distance of 70 meters.
